title: Everus Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results, Raises 2026 Guidance
summary: Everus Construction Group (NYSE: ECG) today reported financial results for second quarter 2026. Second Quarter 2026 Summary (All comparisons versus the prior-year period unless otherwise noted, and results denoted with * are quarterly records.) Revenues of $1.23 billion*, up 33.7%. Net income of $83.9 million*, up 58.9%; net income margin of 6.8%. Diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $1.64*, up 59.2%. Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) of $128.6 million*, up 52.7%; EBITDA margin of 10.4%. Backlog of $4.55 billion*, up 41.0% from Dec. 31, 2025, and up 52.8% from June 30, 2025. Net leverage of 0.3x. On July 31, Everus announced that it entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Epsilon Industries. See the Non-GAAP Measures sections for definitions and reconciliations of the non-GAAP financial measures used in this news release.
